I filed [#42](https://factory.example/cards/card-1) for acme/api and moved it to Execute, so work has started. Deliveries will retry on 5xx responses, network errors and timeouts. Each failed attempt gets logged, and so does the final give-up. Tests will cover a delivery that works after a temporary 5xx, one that gives up after the last attempt, and a 4xx that isn't retried.
